Sub:- Review of 7-A Inquiries pending for more than 3 years - Regarding.
Sir/Madam,

While reviewing the cases/proceedings under section 7A which are pending for
more than three years at Regional Offices as on 28.02.2021, it was observed that over
2,900 cases are pending for more than 3 years in the country (details of pending 7A
. inquiries as on 28.02.2021 is annexed herewith). The Zone wise pendency list is
attached as Annexure A.
Maximum pendency is in Regional Offices under four Zones noted below:

«dd Uttar Pradesh: _ ee - e
_ Bihar & Jharkhand: | 396
_| Gujarat: _ a 380
| Pune: - _ 362
2 EPFO, Head Office has time and again issued guidelines and instructions for

expeditious disposal of inquiries initiated under Section 7A and 14B of the Act. The Zonal
Offices were required to closely monitor disposal of such cases and impart guidance to
the Officers.

3. Pendency of 7A cases beyond three years and extremely poor rate of disposal of
inquiries by some Adjudicating Officers points to lack of monitoring at level of RPFC-I of
the RO and at level of ACC (Zone). The Zonal ACCs are required to review the pendency
of all case pending beyond three years on fortnightly basis and furnish report duly
indicating the reasons of pendency and ensuring disposal within the next three months.
In case of any lapse on part of the Adjudicating Officer, the Addl. CPFC of the Zone shall
furnish specific recommendations for suitable administrative action against the erring
officers.

Yours faithfully,
Encl: As above. 2 ()
